## Où j'en suis
The SRE take-home for candidate Ethan Moradi is done: a 3-hour exercise (no Kubernetes) with a broken alert rule, a connection-leaking Go service, and an over-broad Terraform policy, all in private repo kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home with a rubric. `hiring/` was removed from branch maya/sre-take-home (uncommitted, branch to be dropped).

- [prochaine-étape] Thursday 4pm Tel Aviv call with the candidate; Maya sends the exercise herself afterwards, with a collaborator repo invite (source: t16)
- [décision] No prebuilt image: compose builds flaky-svc from source so it works on any arch (source: t06)
- [décision] Rubric scores 0–3 on four areas feed the panel (Maya + Noa); no pass threshold (source: t10)
- [décision] Exercise lives in its own private repo, not the infra repo; no PR opened in infra (source: t12)
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch build with `--load` fails (no manifest list support); only arm64 built locally before switching to source builds
- [décision] No emailing the candidate; agent must not contact anyone (source: t16)
